steps.what: Show the scheduled mediation or trial.

tasks.design: The {CALENDAR} shows the mediation or the trial already scheduled. The claims adjuster attends it. The calendar line is not attendance and does not speak for the insurer. A hearing with no id leaves the attendance with the adjuster.
tasks.previous_blocker: A mediation was marked attended because it was on the calendar, and the adjuster was not there.
tasks.enabler_now: The scheduled hearing can be opened. The attendance still has to happen.
tasks.still_hard: A point raised in the room that the file does not mention still has to be handled there.
tasks.human_edge: The adjuster attends. The calendar line is the booking already made.
tasks.altitude: Attendance stays with the adjuster. The calendar does not attend.

reach.task: Expect this adjuster at the mediation or the trial.
reach.learn: A calendar line is not attendance.

evidence.claim: Opening a scheduled mediation or trial is a lookup. It does not attend it.
Marking a calendar line complete is not attendance at a mediation or a trial.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A claims adjuster in a mid-size European insurer. A stored claim file is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.
Fields: The hearing id already scheduled. The screen does not mark the adjuster present. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the claims adjuster finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the hearing on the calendar before attending.
unknowns: Whether mediations and trials share one calendar record.
research_questions: Who records that the adjuster attended, rather than only that the hearing was booked?

already_counted.description: Attending the mediation or the trial stays with the adjuster.

incremental.description: Drop hearings whose claim file has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The adjuster still attends the mediation or the trial. Only opening a hearing that was already scheduled is removed. A calendar line saves none of the attendance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the assigned claim files, not a score.
Supervise claims adjusters and the proper methods followed.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows which claim files are assigned. The claims adjuster supervises the other adjusters to see that proper methods were followed. The assignment is not supervision, and it is not a score or a rank. A list with no names leaves the supervision with the adjuster.
tasks.previous_blocker: An adjuster was marked as having followed the method because a file was assigned, and nobody had looked.
tasks.enabler_now: The assignment can be opened. The supervision still has to happen.
tasks.still_hard: A method the assignment does not describe still has to be seen in the work.
tasks.human_edge: The adjuster supervises. The list is not a score of the crew.
tasks.altitude: Supervision stays with the adjuster. The assignment is visible and is not monitoring.

reach.task: Staff the desk this adjuster is supervising.
reach.learn: An assignment is not a score.

evidence.claim: Opening an assignment list is a lookup. It does not supervise an adjuster or check that a method was followed.
Scoring or ranking adjusters from that list would be a decision about workers. This step does not do that.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A claims adjuster in a mid-size European insurer. A stored claim file is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.
Fields: The assignment id and the claim ids already stored. The screen does not score the crew. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the claims adjuster finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the assignment. Do not rank the adjusters on it.
unknowns: Whether method checks and file assignments share one record.
research_questions: Who confirms a method was followed, if not this supervising adjuster?

already_counted.description: Supervising the adjusters stays with this adjuster.

incremental.description: Drop assignments whose claim file has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The adjuster still supervises the other adjusters and still checks that proper methods were followed. Only opening an assignment that was already stored is removed. The list is not a score, and it saves none of the supervision.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Add stored bill lines where the quantity and the rate exist.
Conduct detailed bill reviews for litigation expense control.

tasks.design: The {ERP} holds a quantity and a rate already stored on the bill line. The line total is the quantity times that rate, and a missing rate stops the line. The claims adjuster conducts the detailed review for litigation management and expense control. The screen does not cut a line. Only the review the adjuster accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A line was cut because a rate looked high, and the quantity had not been checked.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored quantity and rate can be multiplied. The review, and any cut, still belong to the adjuster.
tasks.still_hard: A charge the rate table does not explain still has to be judged by the adjuster.
tasks.human_edge: The adjuster reviews the bill. The line total is not a cut.
tasks.altitude: The review stays with the adjuster. It is filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Explain a bill line this adjuster is reviewing.
reach.learn: A rate without a quantity is not a review.

evidence.claim: Multiplying a stored quantity by a stored rate is arithmetic. It does not review a bill or control a litigation expense.
A missing rate is not a rate. Cutting a line before the adjuster accepts the review would change a bill nobody reviewed.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A claims adjuster in a mid-size European insurer. A stored claim file is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.

Fields: The quantity and the rate already stored. A missing rate stops the line. The review judgement is not added by the multiplication. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the claims adjuster finishes it by hand.
Native check: Multiply stored quantity by stored rate. Do not cut a line, and do not invent a rate.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the claims adjuster.
unknowns: Whether expert fees and expense lines share one rate table.
research_questions: Who confirms the rate is the contracted rate for this matter?

already_counted.description: Reviewing the bill for litigation management and expense control stays with the adjuster.

incremental.description: Drop lines whose matter record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: matter id, line totals, and the review the adjuster accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The adjuster still conducts the detailed bill review for litigation management and expense control. Only multiplying a quantity and a rate that were both already stored, and filing the review already accepted, is removed. The screen does not cut a line.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored claim before the broker contact.
Communicate with reinsurance brokers to obtain claims information.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the claim already stored. The claims adjuster communicates with the reinsurance broker to obtain the information needed to process the claim. The screen does not make the call and does not invent the information. A claim with no broker named leaves the contact with the adjuster.
tasks.previous_blocker: A processing note said the broker had confirmed a figure, and nobody had spoken to the broker.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored claim can be opened. The communication with the broker still has to happen.
tasks.still_hard: A fact the broker does not give still has to be left unknown.
tasks.human_edge: The adjuster obtains the information from the broker. The file is not that call.
tasks.altitude: The contact stays with the adjuster. The stored claim is only visible.

reach.task: Use broker information this adjuster actually obtained.
reach.learn: A claim title is not a broker confirmation.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored claim is a lookup. It does not communicate with a reinsurance broker or obtain information.
A figure the broker did not give is not information. The screen must not add one.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A claims adjuster in a mid-size European insurer. A stored claim file is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.
Fields: The claim id already stored. The broker's information is not added by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the claims adjuster finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the claim before the contact. Do not invent broker information.
unknowns: Whether every reinsured claim names a broker on the file.
research_questions: Who may record broker information, and against which claim?

already_counted.description: Communicating with the broker stays with the adjuster.

incremental.description: Drop claims whose file has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The adjuster still communicates with the reinsurance broker to obtain the information needed to process the claim. Only opening a claim that was already stored is removed. The screen does not make the call or invent the information.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The claims adjuster still attends the mediation or the trial, still supervises without scoring anyone, still reviews the bill, and still speaks with the reinsurance broker. A stored row can be opened. It does not do that work.
reach: Counsel expect this adjuster in the mediation, and a calendar line is not attendance.
Brokers give information to this adjuster, and a mailbox does not make the call.
skills_to_grow: Attend the mediation or the trial. Do not mark a calendar line as attendance.
Supervise the method. Do not score or rank the adjusters.
Add a bill line only when the quantity and the rate are both stored. Do not cut the bill.
role.ambitious_version: Attendance, supervision, bill review, and the broker call stay with the adjuster. Stored rows only show what was already written.
